messages:
maya: opening a short PR to add Tempest-6b to the model catalog. includes limits, a migration note from Tempest-3b, tiny bench rows, and both py/js SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/13022
sam: nice. can we be explicit about the max_total_tokens for streaming vs single-shot generate? customers keep hitting silent truncation.
maya: good call. plan: list two fields in the card: max_input_tokens (prompt only) and max_completion_tokens (per request cap), and state "max_total_tokens = prompt + completion" with an inline example.
elaine: also add a short migration bullet: "If you previously used tempest-3b, use tempest-6b for higher quality; consider tuning temperature and max_tokens due to different tokenization."
rik: runtime requests a note about context window behavior for quantized CPU fallback. ops sees misconfigured fallbacks causing OOMs. propose: "cpu-quant recommended up to 4096; above that use GPU-backed tempest-6b-long or Dedicated."
ton y: (typo in previous message) tony: add small bench numbers into the card (p50/p95 and tokens/sec) so customers can estimate cost. prefer inline one-line rows, not big tables.
maya: pasted compact bench snippet into the PR: "gpu-fp: p50 95ms (120 tps), p95 160ms (95 tps); gpu-quant: p50 110ms (90 tps), p95 200ms (70 tps); cpu-quant (4k): p50 1200ms (6 tps), p95 2200ms (3 tps)"
sam: can you add a tiny note about variance by seq length? e.g., numbers are measured at 1024 tokens.
maya: added parenthetical (numbers measured at 1k context).
el aine: product wants examples for both streaming (low-latency UI) and batch generate (high-throughput background). include Python stream and JS generate snippets. make them copy-paste ready.
maya: added examples. python stream:
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key="$REDWOOD_KEY")
with client.stream(model="tempest-6b-long") as stream:
    stream.send("Summarize the customer feedback in 3 bullets")
    for chunk in stream:
        print(chunk.delta, end="")
```
js generate example:
```javascript
import Redwood from '@redwood/sdk'
const client = new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_KEY })
const res = await client.generate({ model: 'tempest-6b', prompt: 'Write a short summary', max_tokens: 200 })
console.log(res.text)
```
rik: runtime asks we include a fallback_policy example to reduce support noise. adding small YAML snippet helps.
maya: added fallback YAML in PR:
```yaml
fallbacks:
  - prefer: temp est-6b-long (gpu)
  - fallback: tempest-6b-quant-cpu
  - cpu-quant-max-context: 4096
```
sam: small copy edit: change "temp est-6b-long" -> "tempest-6b-long" in YAML (typo). also add a one-line handling note: "Requests exceeding max_total_tokens return 413 Payload Too Large."
maya: fixed typo, added the 413 note and a short SDK error-handling snippet for Python showing check for 413 and showing client-side token counting suggestion.
el aine: link-checker flagged /models/tempest-6b-long#variants as missing because our templates expect hyphenated anchor. can you add redirect or update anchor in the model-variants section?
maya: updated anchors and added a frontmatter redirect in the PR. also added a tiny "Known differences" note comparing tokenization between tempest-3b and tempest-6b.
docs-bot: preview deployed for PR 13022: https://deploy.preview.redwood/docs/changes/13022 -> link-checker: 1 broken link remaining (/sdk/examples/tempest)
maya: that was an old example path referenced in the migration note. fixed to point to /docs/sdk/examples and re-ran link-check locally. pushed fix.
docs-bot: link-checker: all links OK. preview: https://deploy.preview.redwood/docs/changes/13022
ton y: small nit: can we shorten the bench blurb for readability? product wants a single line under Performance with the numbers, not a paragraph.
maya: condensed to a single line per variant as requested. pushed.
sam: LGTM from docs side. rik: are you good to sign off on runtime wording?
rik: yes, runtime ok. emphasized that CPU-quant numbers are best-effort and may vary on shared infra. added that sentence.
maya: merging after CI passes. will add changelog entry and close ticket. thanks all! :shipit:
docs-bot: merged PR 13022. changelog updated. preview URL archived.
